title: rogiera standleyana
intro: Rogiera standleyana, commonly known as the Yellow Bird Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is said to possess health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Rogiera standleyana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
